segments.rendered: I can help with these tools:

I can: search the product catalog; look up what a catalog code means; show a store's carried codes and suspected gaps with their evidence; calculate the assortment coefficient score change from adding codes to a store; compare two proposed sets of codes for the same store; find decisions your team recorded, with who recorded them and when; save a decision to shared memory when you tick the consent box. I can also answer questions about this room's conversation.
